cases.name: rotation_v1_v2_v3
cases.description: Two ordinary rotations, each signed by the current_kid of the key set before it.

cases.name: recovery_chain_in_enroll_result
cases.description: An endpoint trusting recovery key 1 missed the replacements by keys 2 and 3 and a recovery: the approved EnrollResult carries the replacement R2 signed by R1, R3 signed by R2, the key set (2, 1) signed by R3 and the key set (2, 2), and a result signed by a key only the chain makes trusted.

cases.name: recovery_chain_in_documents
cases.description: An enrolled endpoint trusting recovery key 1 reconnects and receives the same recovery chain in a Documents message.

cases.name: enroll_result_queried_again
cases.description: The same EnrollResult received twice: the second time every chain document is a duplicate and the enrollment succeeds again.

cases.name: enroll_result_after_part_of_chain
cases.description: The endpoint has already taken the two recovery key replacements, then receives the EnrollResult with the whole chain.

cases.name: next_version_signed_by_non_current_key
cases.description: Key set (1, 3) signed by customer key version 1, which is in the keys of (1, 2) but not its current_kid.

cases.name: keyset_gap
cases.description: Key set (1, 5) arrives at an endpoint holding (1, 3).

cases.name: recovery_keyset_for_other_customer
cases.description: A key set of the next epoch signed by the trusted recovery key, whose customer_endpoint_id is another customer's.
